# 1.2.52 - a sound for the rebuttal, and windows that move

Asked for after 1.2.51 on a live world. Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## Sound

- **The rebuttal has a sound of its own.** The Sound panel has a new row,
  *Rebuttal*, under Incident beside the Objection. It plays for the whole table
  when a rebuttal starts - after an Objection's minute, or when the GM opens one -
  and not again while it carries on. Like every sound in the module it plays
  nothing until the GM chooses a file for it.

## Fixed

- **The Sound and Room Setup windows can be dragged down again** under Stained
  Glass. Both measure all their tabs, and Foundry was told the tallest tab's
  height while the window showed the one on screen, so it would not let the
  window's top leave the top of the screen.
- **The pause covers the whole screen.** It started 16 px down, leaving a strip
  of the map uncovered across the top.

## On the map

- **Project icons are larger again** under Isometric Perspective: between the
  full-size picture of 1.2.50 and the small one of 1.2.51. Project tokens already
  on a map take the new size the next time the GM loads the scene.

275 regression tests pass on a live world.
